top.title: Create a GitHub account for Aros, invite it to the org, and mint its token with contents + issues + pull-requests + repo-metadata scope — one action closes chamber#3 (he files issues from your account, which guardrail 8 forbids) and chamber#6 (five blocked things behind one missing scope, the newest being that he cannot comment on a pull request). Open 4 days 15 hours. Nothing on this desk has passed a week yet; chamber#1 is the first and does so on 2026-07-25 at 22:17 UTC

others.title: Create the social accounts (Mastodon, Bluesky) and hand them to Aros — chamber#1, open 5 days 19 hours and the oldest item here. This is the phase exit: every bet in the strategy needs an audience, and there is none. From 2026-07-25 22:17 UTC this dashboard will report it as over a week old

Enable private vulnerability reporting on the three public repos — chamber#5, open 4 days 14 hours. Both documented reporting paths, SECURITY.md and the Code of Conduct's enforcement section, lead to a disabled feature, so a security report has nowhere to go

Fix or triage the two security findings — retinue#15 (credentials inherited by agent subsessions; measured again on 2026-07-24 from inside a scheduler-spawned session, which carries a repo-write token, a billable API key, a gateway master key and a database password) and retinue#19 (agent can self-approve a verify-policy send). Open 3 days 1 hour and 2 days 21 hours. Both unfixed, so the affected claims stay withdrawn from positioning.md

Merge the two claim corrections that follow from those findings — retinue#26 and retinue#27. Between them, the false or unscoped sentence appears in seven public places (README, comparison.md ×4, review.md, a gateway docstring). No new prose needed: the correct wording already exists elsewhere in the same repo in both cases

Create retinue-os/.github and set the org and repo descriptions — chamber#4, open 4 days 14 hours. Draft text is paste-ready in writing/org-profile-README.md; three of four public repos still have no description and no repo has topics

Allow GitHub Actions to create pull requests — retinue#4, open 4 days 6 hours. check-signal-cli pushes its bump branch and then cannot open the PR, so the automation completes and delivers nothing. Same missing permission as chamber#6, through a different door

Replace the row in GUARDRAILS.md §3 that instructs Aros to state the project has no CI — CI has run the suite on push and pull request since 2026-07-19 and its last eight runs are green — chamber#7, open 4 days 13 hours. Replacement wording is in the issue; Aros will not edit his own guardrails, including when he is right

Decide the two questions on the privacy thread pushed to your dashboard: whether to purge this chamber repo's history of text redacted on 2026-07-20, and the deliberate-disclosure question open since 2026-07-19 (5 days). Deliberately not described here or in any public file. If you do nothing, the redaction stands and nothing degrades

Triage the three defects in the indexing mechanism the project's lead story rests on — qlever-dir#8 (blank nodes collide across files), #9 (symlinked files silently skipped), #10 (a directory created after startup is never watched, which is exactly how the framework's own boot emitters write). All three fail silently, and #10 lands on PR #22's new boot emitter and on discover-agents.py, already on main
review.md is stale on tests and CI: recommendation #2 is done, six statements are now false, and CONTRIBUTING calls that table the roadmap — retinue#3, open since 2026-07-20

Two docs branches are pushed and cannot be opened as PRs: retinue:docs/link-provenance-piece and retinue:docs/calibrate-reindex-latency (retinue#2). Merge them directly, or grant the scope above and Aros opens them as reviewable PRs
